items.rationale: Documentation architecture describes one shared SWAP5 kernel and introduces no alternate production kernel.
Scientific documentation and provenance remain outside the computational kernel; legacy file semantics are explicitly adapter-side.
Traceability and documentation policies distinguish parameters, forcing, persistent state, numerical configuration and results.
No runtime state is added; documentation metadata is external and immutable-data relationships are explicit.
No solver scratch ownership or worker scratch design is changed.
No production storage layout, batching or memory-layout assumption is introduced.
Transaction semantics are documented as checkpoint, trial/retry, commit or rollback and are not altered.
Warm-start and recomputation semantics are not changed; evidence must remain bound to correct committed-state authority.
Documentation architecture requires generic [t0,t1] semantics and forbids implicit day-boundary assumptions.
No coupling-window duration is fixed by this workunit; generic coupling-window documentation is retained.
Coupling remains first-class in the traceability architecture and is not moved outside scientific documentation scope.
The groundwater interface contract is not changed and any future application accuracy claim requires its own authority.
Mass conservation remains absolute; documentation and Status A/AA policy cannot relax scientific mass gates.
Interface sensitivity documentation is supported by the traceability spine and no sensitivity contract is removed or weakened.
No coupling execution path or production cost is changed.
MultiSWAP remains a primary documented use case and no per-column heavy solver architecture is introduced.
No one-to-one MODFLOW mapping assumption is introduced; application and system-composition records can represent tiles separately.
Deep-vadose remains an optional external component and is not folded into SWAP by the documentation model.
No component-transition water accounting is changed; conservation evidence remains source-bound.
T0-T14 traceability is solver-agnostic and can describe multiple soil-water solvers behind common interfaces.
Documentation reuses qualified SWAP physics/evidence by reference and explicitly forbids importing legacy implementation as current scientific truth without lineage assessment.
Implementation mappings target public contracts and exact production symbols; documentation does not require other modules to know HeadCalc internals.
Physical options, parameters and numerical policies are explicitly separate documentation dimensions.
No performance policy or fallback behaviour is changed; performance evidence cannot substitute for scientific qualification.
Reference/full-accuracy authority and historical evidence remain separately identifiable and are never overwritten by documentation views.
Diagnostics are documented as observable evidence rather than persistent physical state.
No optional functionality gains runtime memory or compute cost from this documentation-only workunit.
Runtime/coupler composition responsibilities remain outside the SWAP kernel and can be represented explicitly in application traceability.
Policies explicitly reject silent assumptions about .swp files, calendar days, direct MODFLOW attachment or undocumented source authority.
F-DOC01 is explicitly audited here against all 30 SWAP core architecture invariants before qualification.
